subtitle.zh-CN: 小胖鲨鱼 · 笑出小尖牙
subtitle.zh-TW: 小胖鯊魚 · 笑出小尖牙

description.zh-CN: 圆滚滚的浅蓝小鲨鱼，总是张大嘴笑出一排小尖牙，喜欢拿着风车跑，也爱坐在码头边拍云。
description.zh-TW: 圓滾滾的淺藍小鯊魚，總是張大嘴笑出一排小尖牙，喜歡拿著風車跑，也愛坐在碼頭邊拍雲。
description.en: A round little pastel-blue shark who grins with a row of tiny teeth. Loves running with a pinwheel and photographing clouds from the pier.

look: chubby baby shark: soft pastel periwinkle-blue body (#aecbf2), one rounded pear-shaped body where head and torso merge with no neck, big white belly and white lower face, wide open happy mouth (salmon-pink inside) with tiny white triangle teeth on the upper lip, happy closed-arc eyes, pink blush cheeks, three tiny stroke marks on top of the head, a pointed fin flap on each side of the head, short paddle-like flipper arms, smooth stubby round feet with no toes, small rounded tail fin
